description: Generated from packages/advisers/lib/error-codes.js by scripts/check-contracts.mjs --update. The registry is the single source of truth for CLI error codes; do not edit it by hand.

codes.remedy: Fix the quote/proposal money fields: quantities, unit prices and tax/discount rates are decimal strings within the template limits.

the audit anchor HMAC does not match; treat this as tampering or a changed audit key and restore from a trusted backup
the audit anchor file is malformed; inspect it and write a fresh anchor (never delete audit rows to make it match)
the audit anchor is HMAC-keyed but the audit key is unavailable; restore $ADVISERS_HOME/audit.key (do not regenerate it, the existing chain would verify as BROKEN)
Audit anchor/chain integrity check failed; do not repair the chain automatically — investigate and restore from a trusted backup.

the audit last row was rewritten or rolled back; restore from a trusted backup and investigate
the audit tail was deleted or the database was rolled back; do not delete or rebuild audit rows — restore from a trusted backup and investigate

The pet-brief command failed unexpectedly. Re-run with --check to see structural errors and report the message if it persists.
pre-import safety backup failed; the bundle was not applied and the current database is unchanged. Fix the backup path/permissions and retry.
the bundle manifest/layout/checksums are invalid; do not import it. Re-export on the source machine and verify with `import --bundle --verify --dry-run`.
the bundle exceeds a verification resource limit (file count, single-file or total size). Reject it or split the ledger; no partial import is attempted.
encrypted bundle v1 is not available in this release (plaintext only); `--encrypted` is reserved for a later version.
bundles require the SQLite ledger; unset ADVISERS_STORE=json and retry on a SQLite home.
the bundle checksum/manifest digest does not match; do not import it. Re-transfer the bundle and verify offline before retrying.
the bundle target is unsafe or non-empty (HOME, symlink, existing files without --force/--replace). Choose a new/empty directory.
A calendar entry was skipped (unsupported TZID or invalid time). It is listed in agenda().degraded[]; the rest of the window is still valid.
No memory candidate matched the given id; list pending candidates with `advisers inbox ls` (or `advisers memory candidates`).
capture --rules received no text; pass a non-empty file or stdin.
The capture input exceeds the local-rules limit; split it into smaller messages or raise --max-bytes.
Client alias already belongs to another client; choose a unique alias or merge the clients.
The requested client alias does not exist; run `advisers client show <id>` to inspect aliases.
The client is archived; restore it first or choose an active client.
An active client with the same normalized name exists; use `client show` or merge explicitly.
The client still has active projects; archive/close them first (or use --dry-run to list them).
The client still has open receivables. Settle or void them (or use an explicit supported override) before archiving the client.
Invalid client fields; check --name, --alias, --secrecy and --note.
Cannot merge a client into itself; pass a different source/target id.
Invalid client note; check --summary, --kind and the optional project/matter ids.
The client note id does not exist or was deleted.
The client id does not exist; use `advisers client list`.

The client status pack input, manifest or checksum file is invalid (schema, missing/extra files or a forbidden money-like field). Fix the flagged field/file; a v1 pack never carries receivable/payment amounts.
The client status pack exceeds a verification resource limit (entry count, depth, single-file or total size). The pack is not trusted; ask the sender for a normal-size pack or verify it manually.
Client status pack v1 must not include receivable/payment amounts (reserved for 0.4.1 pending legal review). Keep money columns local and drop --include-receivables.
Pet Brief confidence must be a number between 0 and 1.

A non-interactive consent grant needs an explicit --yes (or ADVISERS_CONSENT_<SURFACE>=1). Read advisers tos show and docs/PRIVACY.md first; this is a separate model-egress consent, not TOS acceptance.
The local content-safety classifier blocked this content. Do not retry the same content; review it first.
the context pack manifest digest does not match the expected SHA-256; the pack was modified in transit or the wrong expectation was supplied.
a requested context-pack id is missing or no longer pending/visible; re-run candidates and choose visible ids.
a requested context-pack entry became stale/superseded; rebuild candidates and confirm again.
context packs are disclosure artifacts and cannot be imported back; they grant no read/execution authority.
the context pack manifest/payload/checksums are invalid; do not trust or forward it.
the context pack exceeds its limits (16 items, 8 KiB/item, 32 KiB items, 64 KiB manifest, 256 KiB total). Narrow --ids or split the subject.
a context-pack candidate belongs to a protected matter above the current clearance; it was excluded. Raise clearance explicitly only if authorized.
a requested record kind cannot be disclosed in a context pack; choose commitments/facts/preferences/delivery metadata only.
Pet Brief counts must be integers and match the array lengths.

The local IMAP credential file is unsafe (group/other-readable, a symlink, corrupt or wrong format). chmod 700 the credentials directory and 600 the file, or delete it and re-add the account; advisers refuses to read it.
Back up the database file and restore from a backup; never delete it. Run `advisers doctor --check-db` for a diagnosis.
Another advisers writer holds the instance lock. Close it or wait and retry; ADVISERS_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS controls the wait.
Invalid delivery lineage or template metadata; check the client/project and template fields.
a demo step failed in the isolated demo home; no real HOME was touched. Re-run `demo` and report the failing step/artifact.
Pet Brief requires an explicit displayPolicy (public|private|none) when --strict is used.
The --due expression contains conflicting dates; pass one explicit date or ISO timestamp.
Could not parse --due; use 今天/明天/后天/周X/下周X/月底/YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO timestamp.
Pet Brief ids must be unique within each array.
A contract field has a value outside its allowed set; see docs/PET-BRIEF-PRODUCER.md for the allowed values.
The Pet Brief is older than its expiresAt; regenerate it.
Unknown or deleted fact at this clearance. Run `advisers fact ls` (or pass --include-deleted to inspect a tombstone) and use an existing fact id.
An active mail followup already tracks this message and counterparty. Run advisers mail followup ls and use that row instead of adding a duplicate.
Mail followup arguments or state transition are invalid (pass exactly one of --mail/--thread, a known dismiss reason, or a legal state change). Check advisers mail followup --help.
Unknown mail followup id. Run advisers mail followup ls --all and use an existing wr_ id.
The payload contains a field forbidden by the closed Pet Brief contract; remove it.
A file/directory permission was denied. Close any program holding the file (antivirus/OneDrive/sync client) and retry, or pick a writable path.
Pet Brief items must carry a non-empty string id.
IMAP authentication failed. Check the account username and app password; providers may require an app password (OAuth is not supported in 0.4.0).
The IMAP server sent an unparseable/rejected response or a non-read-only command was refused. Check server compatibility and retry; advisers only reads mail.
The IMAP request timed out. Check the network/server and retry; advisers never falls back to cleartext.

The IMAP TLS connection or STARTTLS upgrade failed, or the server certificate is not valid for the configured host. Fix the server/certificate or use implicit TLS on 993; advisers never falls back to cleartext.
The mailbox UIDVALIDITY changed, so the sync cursor needs a full rescan. Run `advisers mail sync <account> --full`; no local messages are deleted.
A KB batch item failed without a coded error; this is a fallback label, not a stable contract. Retry the file alone and report the message if it persists.
The filesystem reported an I/O error; the write was aborted and the temp file removed. Retry on a healthy disk.
Internal output guard: non-JSON bytes (ANSI/OSC/control characters) were detected on a --json stream. Fix the writer; do not strip bytes at the consumer.
A JSON input file is malformed; fix the file (or regenerate it) before retrying.
This document is already indexed. Re-run with --replace to re-index it, or skip the file.
No extractable text was found. A scanned/image file is reported as needs-OCR and is not indexed in 0.4.0; store a text-based version or a PDF with a text layer.
The file bytes are neither valid UTF-8 nor decodable as GB18030, so nothing was indexed. Convert the file to UTF-8 and retry.
Invalid KB input (file path, kind/relation/scope, symlink or page id). Pass an existing regular file and a documented kind/relation/scope; see `advisers kb add --help`.
At most 200 files can be indexed in one KB batch. Split the batch and retry.
Unknown, hidden-above-clearance or tombstoned KB document. Run `advisers kb ls` and use an active document id.
Unknown, hidden-above-clearance or not-yet-built KB page. Rebuild/derive the page (`advisers kb page rebuild`) or use an existing page id.
The KB source file cannot be read (missing, permission or I/O error), so nothing was indexed. Check the path and permissions and retry.
The file or an archive member exceeds the KB ingestion budget (50 MB file, 2 MB text, 500 PDF pages, ZIP entry/expansion caps). Split or shrink the file; limits are reported, never silently dropped.
Unsupported file type for KB ingest. Index md/txt/docx/xlsx/pptx/ofd/pdf/eml files; scanned images need no OCR in 0.4.0.
Run `advisers init` to create the local ledger; the read-only facade never creates it.
Retry in a moment; a long-running writer may be checkpointing the ledger.
Back up state.db (do not delete it), then run `advisers doctor`; do not rebuild or replace the file.
Use a local writable directory for ADVISERS_HOME and make sure this process may read state.db; network/synced volumes and read-only mounts are not supported.
A contract string field is outside its min/max length; truncate or split it.
Unknown mail account. Run `advisers mail account ls` and use an active account name or id.
Invalid mail account/import configuration (host, port, TLS mode, retention or dates). Fix the flagged field; cleartext IMAP is refused, use implicit TLS on 993 or STARTTLS.
No stored credential for this mail account. Run `advisers mail account add` again and enter the password through the TTY prompt or --pass-stdin (never argv).
Unknown mail message. Run `advisers mail ls` and use an existing message id.

Model extraction is opt-in and disabled here (needs --model --yes and ADVISERS_API_KEY, and is refused for protected/secrecy>0 matters). Use the default local extraction or grant the model path explicitly.
mail extract --model sends message text to the model provider and needs an explicit --yes. The default local path is offline; pass --model --yes only after consent.
The message body was not retained (metadata-only row or purged by retention). Metadata and body_sha256 are kept; re-sync the mailbox to read the body again.
An IMAP message/response exceeded the size limit; oversize messages keep header-only metadata. Raise --max-message-bytes only if the server is trusted and memory allows.
The input is not valid JSON; fix the payload before validation.
The matter is archived. Re-activate it with the matter commands or choose an active matter.
The matter belongs to a different client; pick a matter owned by the target client.
Unknown matter id. Run `advisers matter ls` and use an existing id.
A contract array exceeds the item limit; trim it.
Pet Brief suggestedLines exceeds the contract limit; reduce the lines.
A migration is already running or the database is busy; close other writers and retry.
The pre-migration backup failed validation, so the database was not migrated. Keep the backup and run `advisers doctor`.
Not enough disk space. Free space and retry; the temp file was removed and no truncated file was installed.
Invalid payment input (amount, currency, method or paid date). Fix the flagged field and retry; a payment currency must equal its receivable currency.
Unknown payment id. Run `advisers payment ls` and use an existing id.

The policy intent/result audit could not be written, so the side effect was refused. Fix the audit sink/ledger and retry; if details.effectCompleted is true the effect already ran unaudited, so reconcile manually.

Untrusted content would drive a side effect, but no interactive confirmation channel is available. Re-run interactively (TTY) or use an explicitly authorized non-interactive path; do not bypass confirmation.
Explicit consent for this surface + data class + provider is required before model egress. Record a consent grant for those exact fields (and base URL) and retry.

The policy engine denied this side effect (surface/action/data class). Read the decision code/hint, run advisers privacy --matrix, and grant the explicit consent or fix the facts; do not bypass the gate.
Internal fallback recorded when an audited effect threw an uncoded error; not a stable contract. Read the original error, retry the action and report it with diagnostics if it persists.
This egress sink/path is not registered (or is ambiguous), so egress fails closed. Register the path or pass a registered meta.id disambiguator.
Policy facts are malformed or incomplete, so the decision fails closed. Pass the documented fact fields with valid types and re-evaluate.
The target path is a protected or persistence location (credentials/config/HOME persistence). Choose a workspace path instead.
A content-safety verdict is required before this action but was not supplied. Run the configured content-safety check and pass its verdict.
The surface is registered but not wired/enabled in this release, so the action fails closed. Do not bypass the gate; wire/enable the surface first.
The effect does not match the effect digest the decision was issued for. Authorize the actual effect and pass matching effect metadata.
The decision token expired before the effect ran. Authorize again and execute promptly.
The decision token is malformed or was tampered with. Authorize again and use the returned token unchanged.
The one-shot decision token was already consumed. Authorize the action again instead of reusing the token.
The decision token was not issued by this process (or was cleared). Authorize the action again.
The surface/action is not registered in the policy matrix, so the action fails closed. Use a registered surface/action and register new integration points before use.
The target path escapes the workspace boundary. Keep the target inside the workspace or widen it explicitly.
The project is archived; restore it or choose an active project.
The project belongs to a different client; use the project's client.
An active project with the same normalized name exists for this client.
Invalid project fields; check --name, --client and dates.
The project id does not exist; use `advisers project list`.
The KB search query is longer than 200 characters. Shorten the query and retry.
Cannot read the input file; check the path and permissions.
Internal guard: a write was attempted on a read-only store. Open a writable store instead of bypassing it.
The receipt/evidence pack exceeds a verification resource limit (entries, depth, file size or total bytes); ask the sender for a normal pack or verify it manually — the pack was not trusted.
Invalid receivable input (amount, currency, due date, kind or memo). Fix the flagged field and retry; amounts are decimal strings within the minor-unit cap and one of CNY/USD/EUR/HKD.
Unknown or hidden-above-clearance receivable id. Run `advisers receivable ls` and use an active id.
another connection blocked the pre-restore checkpoint; close other advisers processes and retry
Restore operation failed; follow the documented recovery path and keep the pre-restore safety backup.
Restore operation failed; follow the documented recovery path and keep the pre-restore safety backup.
Restore operation failed; follow the documented recovery path and keep the pre-restore safety backup.
the atomic install failed, so the live database is unchanged; retry after closing programs that hold the file (antivirus/OneDrive)
the pre-restore safety backup failed, so nothing was replaced; free disk space/permissions and retry
the installed database did not verify AND rollback failed: stop, keep the pre-restore backup, and recover manually
Restore operation failed; follow the documented recovery path and keep the pre-restore safety backup.
the restore target path is not a regular .db path; refusing to replace it
the installed database did not verify; the pre-restore backup was used to roll back
the database still has a non-empty WAL; checkpoint and close every connection before restoring
The database was written by a newer advisers version. Upgrade the package; do not downgrade the schema.
The database is older than this CLI. Run a writable command (for example `advisers doctor`) to migrate it, or retry if another process is upgrading it.
Pet Brief schemaVersion is unsupported; use schemaVersion 2 (or explicitly allow the v0.1 legacy when supported).
Some selected evidence belongs to protected matters. Remove those ids or lower the matter secrecy locally; packs exclude protected matters by default.
Internal guard: a short write was detected and rejected. Retry on a healthy disk; never accept a truncated file.
Pet Brief field "source" must be "advisers".
The ledger store is missing or unreadable. Run `advisers init` or point ADVISERS_HOME at the right home.
This family command needs the SQLite ledger (KB/mail/money tables live there). Unset ADVISERS_STORE=json and run advisers doctor; the JSON fallback keeps only the nine-table wire ledger.
local and remote ledgers both changed since the last sync; run `sync status --check`, export/backup the local side, then re-run with --force if the overwrite is intended.
sync state is unreadable or from a newer version; the precheck degrades to warnings. Re-run `sync status --check` or clear the state file after backing up.
The template data is invalid; fix the field named in error.details.path and retry.
Could not write the generated document; check the output path and disk.
Unknown template. Use `quote` or `proposal`.
A terminal is required for the hidden secret prompt. Run on a TTY, or pipe one line with --pass-stdin; never put a password in argv.
A contract timestamp must be ISO 8601 with a timezone.
A commitment dueAt could not be parsed; it is reported in degraded[] and left unchanged. Fix the date on the commitment.
Pet Brief expiresAt must be after generatedAt.
Accept the current Terms with `advisers tos accept` (TTY), or pass --accept-tos / set ADVISERS_ACCEPT_TOS=1 for non-interactive use.
Internal guard: a ledger write escaped its transaction. Do not bypass it; this indicates a programming error.
A contract value has the wrong JSON type; see docs/PET-BRIEF-PRODUCER.md.
An error was reported without a specific code. Read the message; this is a fallback label, not a stable contract.
The payload carries a field outside the closed Pet Brief contract; consumers must upgrade before the producer adds fields.
Invalid arguments. Run the command with --help for usage.
The database is sealed. Unseal it with `advisers vault unseal` (or use the sealed-home workflow) before running ledger commands.
Verification failed; inspect the failed check ids/detail in the JSON output and fix the input.
SQLite could not use the WAL file and left it untouched. Run `advisers doctor --check-db`; transactions after the last checkpoint may be lost.
The WAL ends with a torn frame. SQLite recovered the valid prefix; the most recent transactions may be lost. Take a backup.
Could not inspect the WAL file. Close other processes using the database and retry.
Could not write the output file; check the path, permissions and disk.

external.remedy: Pass every required argument with the documented type; see the tool description in the DSH bundle.
Ids must start with cm_ (commitment), fact_ (fact) or pref_ (preference).
No record matched in the preview ledger. Use the CLI (`advisers evidence show <id> --json`) for real-ledger evidence in 0.3.0.
Unexpected adapter failure; retry once and report the message without customer data.
The local content-safety layer blocked the call. Do not retry the same content; review it first.
